name: Hating Others
overview: Scripture teaches that hatred is fundamentally opposed to the fear of the LORD, which leads to hating evil rather than people (Proverbs 8:13). Hatred stirs up conflict and strife, whereas love covers sins and promotes peace (Proverbs 10:12). Concealing hatred with deceit or slander is foolish and destructive (Proverbs 10:18). Believers may face hatred from others for Christ's sake, but perseverance leads to salvation (Matthew 10:22). Therefore, Christians are called to put away bitterness, wrath, anger, and malice, rejecting all forms of hatred in their hearts and speech (Ephesians 4:31).
